release_gates.name: exact_codec_reference_identity
release_gates.reason: No licensed ITU-T G.711 or real transport codec reference, binary, conformance vector or pinned runtime exists. The local 8 kHz 4/8-bit logarithmic compander is a synthetic proxy with global peak normalisation, not G.711 or MP3/AAC/Opus/AMR.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with an exact licensed real-codec reference at a 40-hex revision, a SHA-256 artifact pin, admitted conformance vectors and a declared real-codec matrix (codec, bitrate, mode, sample rate).

release_gates.name: pilot_runtime_and_reproduction
release_gates.reason: The pilot needs numpy, scipy, pystoi and soundfile with recorded wheel digests. The task interpreter has none. An unrelated workspace virtual environment contains them, but it has no lock or wheel digests and is not the pilot environment. The pilot metrics are not reproduced here.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with a pinned runtime (interpreter, package versions, wheel SHA-256, platform), the frozen pilot inputs and a byte-identical three-cold-start reproduction of the pilot metrics.

release_gates.name: rights_cleared_corpus
release_gates.reason: The EARS subset used by the pilot is absent from the workspace, and the rights register has no law-codec or codec entry. Acquisition, evaluation, redistribution, customer deployment, public playback and speaker consent are all unknown.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with a rights-cleared, frozen paired corpus that records acquisition, evaluation, redistribution, deployment and playback decisions plus all required speaker consent.

release_gates.name: exact_reference_parity
release_gates.reason: No approved reference output exists for any frozen input under the exact pilot runtime. The committed stdlib fixture is a mechanical control, not pilot parity or a codec oracle.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with approved outputs for frozen inputs from the exact admitted reference, reproducible across three cold starts and published with input and output digests.

release_gates.name: restoration_quality_evidence
release_gates.reason: Only synthetic SI-SDR and RMSE are computed. STOI, decoded interval accounting, bandwidth stratification, burst/erasure behaviour and peak/timing bounds for a real transport codec do not exist.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with Restoration-profile evidence on a frozen paired cohort: decoded intervals, degradation and bandwidth strata, task-specific quality metrics, output peak bounds and failure controls.

release_gates.name: independent_scoring_and_listening
release_gates.reason: STOI is not computed because pystoi is absent. No independent scorer, perceptual model or permitted listening result exists; the pilot itself records that no human evaluation was run.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with independent scoring and a recorded permitted listening protocol on the admitted cohort, with scorer version, ratings, confidence and any exclusions.

release_gates.name: target_runtime_timing
release_gates.reason: The postfilter is a whole-clip zero-phase forward-backward filter and the quantizer normalises by the global clip peak. Neither is frame-causal; no first-output, tail, pacing, deadline or memory measurement exists.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only with a frame-causal or explicitly delayed streaming design and measured first-output, tail, pacing, deadline, availability and memory behaviour on the target runtime.

release_gates.name: provider_intake_and_default_selection
release_gates.reason: No provider, descriptor, registry entry or default exists. Exposure is deferred before processor intake and no owner decision was made.
release_gates.reopen: Reopen only after RG-01 to RG-07 pass, with an opt-in provider that is OFF by default, descriptor/catalog review and an explicit owner decision.

source_evidence_statements: research/distortion_restoration_20261028.md records four separate restoration tasks and states that the 4-bit mu-law case is a stress proxy, not a standard codec, and that neither proxy models MP3/AAC/Opus transform artifacts, tandem coding or jitter.

scripts/evaluate_distortion_restoration.py builds the narrowband reference with 16 kHz -> 8 kHz resample_poly, applies the proxy, upsamples 8 kHz -> 16 kHz and postfilters at 3900 Hz with butter(4) + sosfiltfilt.
The frozen report aggregate for RST-03 records +0.282 dB SI-SDR for the 4-bit proxy and -4.873 dB for the 8-bit proxy, with STOI effectively unchanged; these are provenance values only.
plan/INVENTORY.json marks the component research-control with the Restoration profile and the plan note to keep the known 4/8-bit proxy separate from real transport codecs.

plan/swarm/VERIFICATION.md requires the Restoration profile: frozen corruption and packet baseline, degradation/erasure/bandwidth strata, discrete concealment validity, decoded intervals, quality and peak/timing bounds.
